problems.why: No finding says the icons on the labels are weak or fail to set the labels apart; finding 3 is about telling the funds apart because of similar names and too many tags, and finding 5 is about jargon.

Findings 3 and 5 are about the tags, but they complain that there are too many funds and tags and that the tag wording is jargon; neither says the icons on the labels are weak or fail to tell the labels apart.
